facts.business: Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited executes infrastructure projects, primarily work contracts, and is setting up a lithium-ion battery plant.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Priorities for FY 2026-27: expand market presence, strengthen digital capabilities, and embed sustainability into everything we do.
guidance_or_targets.value: Expand market presence, strengthen digital capabilities, embed sustainability

key_risks: Revenue recognition from work contracts involves judgement in identifying performance obligations, estimating total contract revenue and costs, assessing progress, and determining cut-off.

Significant capital work-in-progress relating to lithium-ion battery plant being supplied by a related party (Electroforce (India) Private Limited), involving assessment of existence, stage of completion, and related-party transaction terms.
facts.related_party_note: Significant transactions with related parties include: Capital expenditure of Rs 2,971.05 lakhs to Electro Force (India) Private Limited for lithium-ion battery plant; Trade receivables from Eternal Building Assets Private Limited (Rs 1,276.96 lakhs) and Garuda Construction and Engineering Private Limited (Rs 304.27 lakhs); Trade payables to Electro Force (India) Private Limited (Rs 1,778.63 lakhs) and PKH Ventures Limited (Rs 219.22 lakhs); Security deposit to PKH Ventures Limited (Rs 100.00 lakhs); Investment in subsidiary Artemis Opto Electronic Technologies Private Limited (Rs 374.41 lakhs).
